payload.title: M4 Hosted editor steering of learned items, and safe undo
payload.description: Edit, retire or add an item -> candidate version -> held-out evaluation -> result for an editor to promote (PublicationSteering exists as a library); report steering:true only once it works end to end. Make undo of a trained-on label stop resetting all learned structure (flywheel.py:763-780), or at minimum warn first. Weeks. Plan: https://claude.ai/artifact/Jg1DpixLFcAvnPy7d9RNDE
